Sun & Moon series · CEC

Cosmic Eclipse

Released November 1, 2019 · 272 cards

Expanded

Cosmic Eclipse is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on November 1, 2019. Its main set has 236 cards, plus 36 secret rares numbered beyond the set (272 in total). It includes 229 Pokémon, 41 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

85 illustrators worked on Cosmic Eclipse. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (14), Ken Sugimori (9), Mitsuhiro Arita (8), PLANETA Tsuji (8), Megumi Mizutani (7), Hasuno (6), sui (6), Akira Komayama (5).
